item.title: Weekend Chillicothe Police Report
item.description: The Chillicothe Police Department report for the weekend includes 191 calls for service. item.title: Trenton / Grundy County Fire Calls
item.description: A reported structure fire Saturday evening in rural Trenton summoned the Grundy County Rural Fire Protection District to 393 Northeast 20th Street. The call came in at about 8:40 and the crew arrived to find a two-story home fully involved. The crew worked to extinguish the fire and stop it from spreading to other structures. […]

item.title: House Fire And Grass Fire Handled By Chillicothe Firefighters
item.description: Chillicothe firefighters responded to two fires Friday. Just before 4:00 pm, they were called to 1103 Calhoun for a structure fire. item.title: Trenton Man Arrested By Troopers
item.description: State Troopers in Harrison County arrested 48-year-old Stephan D. Elliot of Trenton at about 10:56 pm for alleged driving while revoked or suspended, no seatbelt, Careless and Imprudent Driving, and no Insurance. He was taken to the Harrison County Jail.
